description: the man of the reference picture riding: a young god of the night sky, light tan skin, black hair tied back in a ponytail hanging down his back, a handsome lean face in clean profile lit by soft silver light, a slim silver circlet, simple elegant plate armour of deep midnight indigo with silver edges, a long indigo cape lined with silver hanging behind from the shoulders, indigo greaves and boots with silver edges, no bow, no crescent moon, no star and nothing in the hands but the reins; sitting tall and upright astride a saddle that is not drawn, the back straight, not squatting and not crouching, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing right, the head, chest and hips turned fully to the right; both forearms reaching forward, the two hands together in front of the body holding short reins that end just in front of the hands; only the near leg showing and only one foot in the whole picture: the thigh lying forward and level from the hip to the knee, the knee bent at a right angle, the lower leg hanging vertically straight down from the knee, one whole foot at the bottom with the toes pointing right; the cloak and any long hair hanging down behind the back, not spread out; the far leg completely hidden and not drawn at all, no second boot and no second foot; the whole figure from the top of the head to the sole of the foot inside the picture with room around it; nothing under the rider; isolated figure on a plain background

references.usage: the character's look: this same man, his face, ponytail, circlet, armour, cape and colours, drawn the same way; not his standing pose and not the bow, the crescent moon and the star
